purpose: Launch a real interactive Pi CLI/TUI process in a new tab of an existing Zellij session.

provides.name: launch
provides.description: Launch a real interactive Pi CLI session in a new Zellij tab using an existing absolute directory. The launched conversation is not proxied, monitored, or controlled through the protocol.

cwd.description: Existing absolute working directory; control characters are rejected.

model.description: Optional provider/model identifier permitted by package configuration.

thinking.description: Optional Pi thinking level permitted by package configuration.

name.description: Optional non-empty Pi session and Zellij tab name using supported safe characters, at most 120 UTF-8 bytes, and not beginning with '-'.

initialPrompt.description: Optional literal initial prompt, at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters, and not beginning with '-' or '@'.

piSessionId.description: Pi session UUID supplied to the launched CLI.

cwd.description: Canonical directory used for the launched process.
